**Isosyll live: 31.5× real time · 0.331 J/audio-s · 5.08% WER (3.08% dev-clean) on one CPU core**

![Isosyll: Always Listening, Barely Computing. Single-core throughput vs. pooled WER for all 12 timed public CPU speech recognizers and Isosyll live on the 730-utterance LibriSpeech DEV panel, names colored by energy per audio-second](docs/paper/money.png)

**Figure 1.** Isosyll v4.1.0 vs. all 12 timed public CPU speech recognizers on one pinned Zen 2 core: live +LM runs at 31.5× (0.331 J/audio-s, 5.08% WER, 3.08% dev-clean at 160 ms; +0.09 pp vs. Zipformer on unselected DEV) and the utterance-end commit pass reaches 5.02% at 17.0× vs. Zipformer INT8 at 14.0× (0.573 J/audio-s, 5.25%); J/audio-s from the paired full-panel runs (R8 for v4.1.0, R6 for Zipformer). [Paper](docs/paper/paper.pdf) · [Release record](docs/ultra/releases/v4.1.0.md).

- **Fastest, with the lowest measured energy.** On one quiet Zen 2 core, **Isosyll live** (160 ms chunks, +LM) runs at **31.5×** real time and **0.331 J/audio-s** (**5.08%** panel, **3.08%** dev-clean, **5.32%** full DEV WER, **328 MB** RAM): **2.2×** the paired throughput of Zipformer INT8 at **57%** of its energy per audio-second (paired R8 full-panel blocks).
- **One small artifact.** A single 60 MB INT8 model; the utterance-end commit pass on the same weights (the `isosyll transcribe` default) reaches **5.02%** panel WER at **17.0×** real time.
- **Bit-exact pure-Rust engine.** No external runtime or BLAS (AVX2, AVX-512 VNNI, ARM NEON, scalar), with identical transcripts across **18** cross-ISA witness runs.

Measured on one pinned Zen 2 core (730-utterance LibriSpeech DEV selection panel; § = 73-clip timing subset, ‡ = shared-host H0 interim). Unselected DEV C-half, v4.1 live vs. Zipformer INT8: +0.09 [−0.12, +0.30] pp, inconclusive. J/audio-s: idle-subtracted core J per audio-second (CPU-domain registers only, not wall power): comparators from the R7 matched campaign (73-clip subset, median of 2–3 core-clean blocks), Isosyll live from the R8 full-panel blocks under the same protocol. The 0.331 J/audio-s and 57% above are the paired R8 full-panel run. Exploratory DEV-only results; released by owner decision after missing registered edit gates; v4.1 was selected on the DEV selection half and checked once on the unselected half (protocol and limits in the [paper](docs/paper/paper.pdf) and [release record](docs/ultra/releases/v4.1.0.md)).
